event_scope: 2025-03-28 central Myanmar mainshock and source-bounded humanitarian context

as_of.semantics: Mainshock identity is fixed from the supplied official-domain snapshots, with the supplied verified project reference used only to corroborate fields not exposed in the USGS search excerpt. Humanitarian figures retain the reporting date and attribution of each underlying ReliefWeb item; they are not current as of the snapshot-check date.
as_of.limitation: The supplied official-domain files are search-result snapshots rather than downloaded source records. The magnitude type and origin review status are stated in the derived verified-reference file but are not visible in the supplied USGS search excerpt.

primary_event.local_time_derivation: UTC plus 06:30; ReliefWeb independently rounds the event time to 06:20 UTC and 12:50 local.

epicenter.context: Near Sagaing and Mandalay in central Myanmar; ReliefWeb describes the epicentre as about 16 km north-north-west of Sagaing city and 19 km north-west of Mandalay city.

field_provenance.event_id: Visible in the supplied USGS event-page URLs and corroborated by the verified project reference.
field_provenance.origin_time_coordinates_depth_and_value: Supplied USGS official-domain snapshot; ReliefWeb independently corroborates the rounded time, magnitude value, depth, and regional location.
field_provenance.magnitude_type_and_review_status: Supplied verified project reference; these two fields are not exposed in the supplied USGS search-result excerpt.

subsequent_earthquake_reporting_conflict.relationship_to_primary_event: A strong subsequent earthquake occurred within minutes of the mainshock, but the supplied ReliefWeb materials do not use a single consistent magnitude.
subsequent_earthquake_reporting_conflict.safe_handling: Do not normalize the subsequent event to M6.4 or M6.7 without a separate event-level verification. Anchor any downstream temporal design to the Mww 7.7 mainshock at 2025-03-28T06:20:52Z and disclose the potentially confounding subsequent earthquake.

humanitarian_reporting.qualification: The disaster-page search excerpt explicitly attributes these values to ECHO on 11 April 2025 and, for Myanmar, to the AHA Centre.

humanitarian_reporting.qualification: Values appear in the supplied search excerpt and are attributed there to UN OCHA Situation Report No. 4 dated 25 April 2025.

humanitarian_reporting.publisher_as_presented_on_reliefweb: Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan Flash Addendum
humanitarian_reporting.qualification: Planning estimates with a different denominator and purpose from casualty or displacement reports; do not combine them into a single toll.

source_scope.authoritative_event_source: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program event page for us7000pn9s, as captured in the supplied official-domain search snapshot.
source_scope.humanitarian_context_sources: ReliefWeb-hosted disaster, OCHA, ECHO/AHA Centre, UNOSAT, and HNRP excerpts in the supplied official-domain search snapshot.
source_scope.corroborative_project_source: BV1-015 verified-reference output; derived and not treated as an independent external authority.
excluded: damage, outage, recovery, or causal inference

downstream_anchor.safe_wording: We anchor the temporal analysis to the USGS-reviewed Mww 7.7 mainshock near Mandalay and Sagaing at 06:20:52 UTC (12:50:52 Asia/Yangon) on 28 March 2025. ReliefWeb materials also report a strong subsequent earthquake within minutes, but disagree on whether its magnitude was 6.4 or 6.7; this discrepancy is preserved as a source limitation.
downstream_anchor.interpretation_limit: This context fixes when and where the event occurred. It does not establish that any observed nighttime-light change represents outage, damage, recovery, or earthquake causation.
